Name: Viki's Tidy Farmhouse
Author: vikich3rry
Description:
A home should be nice and comfy, a truly cozy place to return to after a hard day's work; and this is my attempt at making the farmhouse just that! The layout is now much more compact and tidy, but keeps the vanilla footprint and main features almost intact, so it feels tinier than vanilla's while still having enough room to decorate freely. With more defined rooms and that tidy cottage feel, it finally feels like the home the farmer deserves!
[line]
[color=#dbb0a7][size=4][b][i]Features[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]A [b]complete redesign of the farmhouse layout![/b] The farmhouse is now a lot more sectioned and compact, nicely separated in rooms with an overall rectangular (and where possible symmetrical) layout![/*]
[*][b]All upgrades are supported:[/b] The starter house is a cozy semi-open space; the 1st upgrade adds a kitchen and pantry to the left, and a hallway and room to the right; the 2nd upgrade adds a second floor with two symmetrical rooms, as well as an extra room on top of the hallway! The 3rd upgrade unlocks the cellar, with the entrance located in the pantry.[/*]
[*][b]Support for most vanilla renovations![/b] Includes 7 renovations: Cubby, Corner Room, Expanded Corner Room, Attic, Open Kitchen, Open Living Room, and of course the Crib. [size=1]Yes, the Southern Room and Dining Room have been yeeted.[/size][/*]
[*]A [b]toggleable kitchenette[/b] in the starter farmhouse, because being able to cook for oneself doesn't have to be locked behind upgrades![/*]
[*][b]Configurable kitchen size[/b] for all upgrades with one: Choose how much space the kitchen should take, or remove it all together if you'd rather build one yourself or use the space for other things![/*]
[*][b]The vanilla footprint as well as its main features remain mostly the same![/b] The entrance, kitchen, stairs, crib, spouse room and cellar are all in the same spot as in the vanilla farmhouse; this should make events taking place inside the farmhouse not look too out of place! It also makes switching from vanilla to this layout mid-game not be [i]too[/i] bad, as most furniture will still be accessible even if it looks shifted, excluding that placed in renovations (those do have a different footprint and furniture in them will end up in the void if not removed beforehand).[/*]
[*][b]Custom starter furniture,[/b] to start the game with a pretty interior made especifically for this farmhouse! Includes a free calendar for extra quality of life. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url].[/*]
[*][b]Specific furniture shifting[/b] with each upgrade, so everything placed inside always stays in the right place after upgrading! Also requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url].[/*]
[/list][line]
[color=#dbb0a7][size=4][b][i]Config[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b]Starter Kitchenette:[/b] Adds a tiny functional kitchen to the starter farmhouse. It only includes the stove and sink, not a fridge, as it's meant to only help players get a start on cooking, not replace the 1st upgrade.[/*]
[*][b]Kitchen Size:[/b] Choose how big you want the kitchen to be; 'Full' for the vanilla L-shape kitchen, 'Big' to remove the vertical part, 'Small' for the basic appliances only, and 'Empty' to completely remove it.[/*]
[*][b]Screenshot Area:[/b] Changes how big the map shows when taking in-game screenshots in the 2nd+ farmhouse upgrade. 'WithRenovations' makes it fit the two upper renovations (Attic & Extended Corner). 'NoRenovations' only focuses on the base layout, so if you prefer playing without renovations you don't have to see all that blank space around when taking screenshots. Both options always fit the Cubby, and the Corner Room only fits in 'NoRenovations' if married.[/*]
[/list][i][color=#fff2cc]NOTE:[/color][/i] Changing the [b]Screenshot Area[/b] mid-game after upgrading to the cellar will make the cellar entrance disappear until the save file is reloaded. There's nothing I can do about it, as it seems to be a thing with reloading map properties while the map is in use. Please only change this setting from the Main Title if possible.
[line]
[color=#dbb0a7][size=4][b][i]Compatibility & Bugs[/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]Fully compatible with any recolor:[/color][/b] It only uses vanilla tilesheets, so it's automatically compatible with all of them![/*]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]Fully compatible with cellar mods[/color][/b] that use the vanilla cellar coordinates![/*]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]Fully compatible with multiplayer,[/color][/b] granted all players have it installed![/*]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]Should be compatible with android:[/color][/b] Make sure Content Patcher is at least at version 2.8.0![/*]
[*][b][color=#fff2cc][i]Probably[/i] compatible with most farmhouse events:[/color][/b] The entrance, kitchen, stairs, crib, spouse room and cellar are all in the same spot as in the vanilla farmhouse, so most events should play correctly with this layout. There might be some minor clipping and off positions in some events, especially if they cover more space, but there's nothing I can do about those.[/*]
[*][b][color=#b6d7a8]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family[/url]'s events:[/color][/b] Most of its events will play well and as intented! The only minor "problem" I've found is the farmer walking through the living room's wall if the Open Living Room renovation isn't active during one event, but it's just a minor, one-time visual bug that is [i]not[/i] game breaking.[/*]
[*][b][color=#fff2cc]Not [i]fully[/i] compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20599]PolySweet[/url]:[/color][/b] If the multiple spouse rooms are [i]not[/i] enabled, [color=#b6d7a8]it should work perfectly fine[/color]. Having multiple spouse rooms at the same time [i]will[/i] cause visual bugs, however.[/*]
[*][b][color=#ea9999]Not compatible with mods that edit the vanilla farmhouse:[/color][/b] Other map replacements, or mods that edit the farmhouse such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27020?]Hallway Fix[/url], will not work, obviously![/*]
[*][b][color=#fff2cc]Known bugs:[/color][/b] The fireplace will be slightly bugged when first creating a save (the middle will be clipping with the wall), simply pick it up and place it down again to fix it! Similarly, the starter gift may be in the wall in some farms, but it's accessible from the tile on top! Both of these are seen in the last picture in Images, and are just a one time thing when making a new farm -- they won't bug or affect your experience in any way.[/*]
[/list]If you find any bugs or incompatibilities that aren't listed here, please report them with a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI Log[/url] attached so I can look into the issue!
[line]
